headline: Software, AI & Systems Engineering
subtitle: Product-minded delivery · AI-assisted development · Reliable applications
pitch: I build AI-enabled applications from customer problems through to production, including recovering an inherited service whose integrations were undocumented. I’d bring that mix of practical delivery and critical checking to Workwize: build something useful, examine the failure modes and improve it from evidence.

profile.text: I build AI-enabled web applications, internal tools and ERP integrations. My commercial work spans discovery, requirements, solution design and implementation, with client coordination, proposals and pricing for the AI and infrastructure work I own.

I recovered an inherited AI-first service by reverse-engineering undocumented integrations, repairing architecture and security issues, and reducing API costs. I addressed prompt/context injection with deterministic validation and human review.

My personal projects explore source-grounded interfaces and reviewable context for coding agents. University work adds interface evaluation and human–AI interaction; earlier warehouse-process work gives me experience documenting operational handoffs and gaps.

bullets.text: Build internal AI tools and production LLM features for web applications and ERP-connected systems, spanning APIs, automation, backend logic and user-facing interfaces.
Work across discovery, requirements, solution design and client coordination, including proposals and pricing for owned AI and infrastructure work.
Reverse-engineered undocumented integration behaviour, repaired architecture and security issues, and reduced LLM API costs.
Identified and addressed a prompt/context-injection vulnerability using deterministic validation and human review.
Turned engineer walkthroughs into initial written instructions for sorting, tracking and handoffs on a warehouse line.
Helped trace gaps in warehouse-line processes and documented the findings for engineers to review.
Supported warehouse-line sorting and distribution handoffs as part of the warehouse-rollout project.
Recorded warehouse-rollout meetings and circulated action items to document discussions and agreed next steps.
Supported on-site connectivity checks at remote telecom locations alongside the warehouse project work.

experience.body: Taught Python, Unity and JavaScript through a block-based visual programming environment, using pre-made curricula.

education.history: University studies began in 2024; changed to the current programme in September 2026.

academic_work.text: Compared interfaces and task times; applied paired t-tests, effect sizes, chi-square analysis, Fitts’ Law and Keystroke-Level Modelling using Figma and JASP.

Developed and evaluated a Furhat SDK/Blockly assistant for international students navigating municipal registration. Assessed task completion, ease of use, friendliness, confidence, trust and clarity through observation, Likert scales and open feedback.
Implemented epsilon-greedy and UCB multi-armed-bandit algorithms with NumPy and compared their behaviour.

milestone.body: Statistics, calculus and matrix algebra; academic writing, research methodologies and network science.
milestone.leadership: Computer Science Society: over one year of leadership alongside Advanced Studies.

projects.title: Client Studio
projects.summary: Company-assistant prototype that answers from supplied text/Markdown and separates customer-facing from internal evidence.

bullets.text: Typed React rendering, lexical retrieval, HttpOnly workspace sessions and session-scoped Supabase persistence support a source-grounded interface.
Approved sources and configurations become immutable snapshots. Human review governs activation; server-side filters enforce audience-specific evidence.
Revision checks, row-lock compare-and-swap and idempotent requests reject stale writes. Inference-budget reservations remain held when usage is unknown.

projects.title: VoidArch Context
projects.summary: Local-first repository memory and retrieval for coding agents, producing relevant context within an estimated token budget.

bullets.text: Ranked Markdown/JSON packs retain provenance and review states, distinguishing confirmed facts from candidate evidence. Delegation packs include objectives, write scope and verification instructions.
Combines BM25 retrieval with Tree-sitter file, symbol and import graphs; SurrealKV stores repository documents, memories, tasks, blockers and run history.
Optional ONNX embeddings add vector search after an explicit embedding pass. The tool runs locally without Docker or Python.

otherPersonalWork: Rust-based coding-agent orchestration using MCP/JSON-RPC over stdio, subprocess sessions and directory isolation. Terminal and desktop tooling includes PTY/WebSocket sessions, Git worktrees, Tauri and local HTTP APIs.
